title: Homemade Polish-Style Pappardelle Pasta
description: A traditional Polish pasta dish made with homemade pappardelle and a rich, yeasty sauce. This recipe is a hearty and comforting meal perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: Flour
ingredients.notes: All-purpose flour for making the pasta dough

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, eggs, and salt. Mix the dough until it comes together.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece out into a thin sheet.
Cut the sheets into pappardelle noodles and set aside.
In a large saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the yeast and milk to the saucepan and whisk until the yeast is dissolved.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5-7 minutes until it thickens.
Add the pappardelle noodles to the saucepan and toss to coat with the yeasty sauce.
Season with salt and serve hot, topped with grated Parmesan cheese.
